name: Toudou Aya
source:
Married partner of the protagonist's father (Shuuichi). Stepmother. Trying to manage the lonely nights due to the father being too busy with work to come home, she becomes sexually frustrated. As her outlet she often uses the protagonist in her husbands absence...

She has a sever character, meaning not one of a mother.
